column3:
A feisty fish I've always been
My joy; my songs, my sea
Lovers were my favorite dish
Their passion was my feast

Solitude was not my fear
Countless suitors I would reap
No sooner one man drowning
Another man would leap

There's a monster deep inside me
Drinking up my dreams
Child, I need to grieve you
Before I'm ripped apart
Child, I need to leave you
Before you eat my heart

Still I bore a sadness
No children had I borne
To Baba the witch Yaga
A pact with her I swore

Sour potion did she offer
Mixed to fill me with desire
I smiled as I fell sleeping
My hand held o'er my heart
